proof_body:
by
  intro f a b ζ N hf hb hN
  have hz : 0 ≤ ζ := (abs_nonneg _).trans (hb a Set.left_mem_uIcc)
  have hcl : IsClosed (Set.uIcc a b) := isClosed_Icc
  have hall : ∀ x, |iteratedDerivWithin 2 f (Set.uIcc a b) x| ≤ ζ := by
    intro x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ Set.uIcc a b
    · exact hb x hx
    · rw [iteratedDerivWithin_succ, derivWithin_zero_of_notMem_closure (by rwa [hcl.closure_eq])]
      simpa using hz
  exact trapezoidal_error_le_of_c2 hf hall hN
target_source: ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a b ζ : ℝ) (N : ℕ), ContDiffOn ℝ 2 f (Set.uIcc a b) → (∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc a b, |iteratedDerivWithin 2 f (Set.uIcc a b) x| ≤ ζ) → 0 < N → |trapezoidal_integral f N a b - ∫ x in a..b, f x| ≤ |b - a| ^ 3 * ζ / (12 * N ^ 2)
